description: Seismic event catalogs from USGS / IRIS / regional networks. Magnitude, depth, location, time. Captures aftershock sequences, b-value distributions, swarms, foreshock signatures.

expected_relationships.rationale: shallow events tend to read higher locally
M ≥ 7 + shallow + offshore raises tsunami risk
larger events generate more felt reports

characteristic_patterns.name: Gutenberg-Richter
characteristic_patterns.detection_rule: linear regression in log-frequency vs magnitude space

characteristic_patterns.name: Earthquake swarm
characteristic_patterns.signature: many similar-magnitude events in tight space-time window without a clear mainshock

characteristic_patterns.name: Foreshock signature
characteristic_patterns.signature: rising small-magnitude rate hours-to-days before a large event
characteristic_patterns.detection_rule: trend in event-rate vs magnitude before the largest event

action_library.label: Issue seismic advisory
action_library.description: When a high-magnitude event with shallow depth in a tsunami-prone zone is detected, push an advisory to local civil-protection channels.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Advisories at this threshold catch most genuinely tsunamigenic events.

action_library.label: Raise station-network cadence in aftershock zone
action_library.description: Boost local-network sampling and waveform retention while an aftershock sequence is active.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Higher cadence improves catalog completeness for B-value estimation.

action_library.label: Investigate swarm
action_library.description: Trigger on-call review when an earthquake swarm pattern persists ≥ 24h.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Reviewers identify mechanism (volcanic / fluid-driven / tectonic) ≈ 60% of the time.

action_library.label: Recompute regional b-value
action_library.description: Re-fit Gutenberg-Richter on a rolling window when the seismicity regime shifts.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Updated b-value recalibrates hazard products downstream.
